title: invokeAction
description:
Run a command against a feature — `turn_on`, `lock`, `snapshot`.

Actions are imperative and may have no corresponding state. Most return an empty object; those that produce something (a snapshot, a mode list) return it under `data`.

params.title: Action arguments
params.description: Shape is action-specific — `move` carries pan/tilt/zoom axes, `set` carries the value.

data.description: Action-specific return value. Absent for actions that only have an effect.
